paperInfo.sourceBasis: ZIMSEC Advanced Level Divinity 9154 syllabus structure: Paper 2 focuses on the Gospels.

questions.questionText: Gospel background: Explain the historical and religious context of this theme, discuss its major teachings or issues, evaluate at least two scholarly interpretations where relevant, and apply the significance of the theme to a contemporary Zimbabwean context.
